run_lammps_with_fairchem: run a LAMMPS simulation using a FairChem MLIP predictor with a given input script and task name
create_atomic_data_from_lammps: create an AtomicData object from LAMMPS atom positions, atomic numbers, cell, and periodicity data
lookup_atomic_number_by_mass: lookup atomic numbers by matching closest atomic masses from a numpy array of target masses
separate_run_commands: separate LAMMPS run commands from the rest of an input script and return both as lists
review_fixexternalcallback_class: review the FixExternalCallback class that computes MLIP forces and virials for LAMMPS external fix callbacks
